services.title: Restorative Dentistry
services.text: It’s true that every smile will likely encounter a little damage at some point in life.
services.lead: It’s true that every smile will likely encounter a little damage at some point in life. Regular oral hygiene and trips to a general dentist can help keep tooth decay, damage, infection and tooth loss at bay, but so many factors affect the health of your smile – you can’t control all of them.

about.title: About Dentistry Of The Oaks
text: Dr. Lindsey Wendt grew up in Spring, TX. She graduated cum laude with a Bachelor’s Degree in Nutritional Sciences from the Texas A&M University with a minor in Business. Her love of dentistry began freshman year of college when she realized just how much she could help people by keeping their smile healthy and happy. Dr. Wendt moved back to Houston to attend the University of Texas School of Dentistry where she received her DDS degree. Dr. Wendt loves working with patients of all ages and loves building relationships with her patients.

Dr. Katie Stuchlik (pronounced “stew-click”) grew up in Houston, Texas and graduated from The University of Texas at Austin. There she obtained degrees in Human Development and Radio-Television-Film, all the while serving as the University’s costumed mascot, Hook ‘Em. After realizing her lifelong goal of editing films for Adam Sandler would never come to fruition, she decided to pursue a career in something completely unrelated but equally as satisfying- dentistry. After graduating college, she spent time working in a research lab at Baylor College of Medicine.

Tina is a dedicated dental hygienist with a Bachelor of Science in Dental Hygiene from Texas A&M College of Dentistry. With a passion for patient care and a commitment to ongoing education, she strives to make a positive impact on every patient she treats. She is particularly interested in welcoming anxious patients to the practice and giving them an enjoyable and comforting experience at the dentist. Outside of the office, Tina is a proud dog mom to Niko, her lovable Golden Retriever.
